summary: Tested 3 fixes: 1) Edit form 'Dashboard Sub-Store' label for sub-store users, 2) Unified navbar on edit page, 3) First login page. All tests PASSED. User 43 (Imededdine safi) and User 28 (imededdine essafi) both show 'Dashboard Sub-Store' label with correct helper text. Navigation between pages works correctly with navbar preserved.

edit_form_substore_label_user43.details: User 43 (Imededdine safi) edit page shows 'Dashboard Sub-Store' label instead of 'Opérateurs Assignés'. Helper text 'Sub-store auquel cet utilisateur est rattache' is present.

edit_form_substore_label_user28.details: User 28 (imededdine essafi) edit page shows 'Dashboard Sub-Store' label with correct helper text.

unified_navbar_on_edit.details: Edit page has unified navbar with logo, Dashboard, Sub-Stores, Utilisateurs (active), Invitations, ML, Permissions, Audit links.

first_login_page.details: First login page loads correctly with 'Votre mot de passe sécurisé', 'Confirmer le mot de passe' fields, and 'ACTIVER MON COMPTE' button.

navigation_from_edit.details: Navigation from edit page to Invitations works correctly. Navbar is preserved on Invitations page.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 fixes verified: 1) Edit form shows 'Dashboard Sub-Store' label for sub-store users (tested with user 43 and 28), 2) Unified navbar added to edit.blade.php via @include('partials._admin-header'), 3) First login page works correctly. The key fix in User.php getPreferredDashboard() using SubStoreService::isSubStoreOperator() is working - sub-store users are correctly identified.
